title: Trump says 'we don't have inflation' as prices continue to rise
summary: Local news on the final pre-midterm CPI: president says there is no inflation and tariffs cause wealth, Republicans blame regulations for diesel, while inflation sits above where it started.

verdicts.note: CPI inflation was three point seven percent in September 2026, nearly double the Fed's target.
CPI-U rose 0.6% in September 2026 and 3.7% over the previous 12 months, with core up 2.6%.
